data.title: Swift TV Shareholders Pass All Annual General Meeting Resolutions
data.description:
An announcement from Swift Networks Group Limited ( (AU:STV) ) is now available.

Swift TV Ltd is a technology company delivering enterprise in-room engagement and entertainment through Swift TV, its all-in-one connected TV product for scalable deployment in mining, oil and gas, aged care and hospitality. The product is designed to unify entertainment, communication and engagement while supporting integrations that optimise business outcomes.

All resolutions put to shareholders at the annual general meeting were passed by poll. They included adoption of the remuneration report, re-election of Bradley Denison, approval of additional 10% placement capacity, approval to issue 4,706,641 shares and 4,706,641 performance rights to Brian Mangano, and ratification of a prior issue of warrants to Pure Asset Management Pty Ltd.

data.title: ShiFang Holding Discloses Chen Ye Funding-Support Proposal
data.description:
ShiFang Holding Limited ( (HK:1831) ) has provided an update.

ShiFang Holding disclosed that executive Director Chen Ye had submitted a funding-support proposal to its board. The proposal is conditional on protection of original shareholders’ rights and interests and includes his stated willingness to contribute at least RMB200 million in cash for sustainable operating funds, intended to help satisfy conditions for resuming trading.

Chen Ye also offered an additional HK$10 million and advances for specified creditor obligations and Chinese Mainland legal fees; major creditors, employees with wage arrears, and certain directors and former directors would cooperate through financial-support documents. If shareholder protection cannot be achieved, Chen Ye and other affected parties may pursue legal proceedings seeking a winding-up on insolvency; several directors supported the proposal, while Chen Zhi expressed no opinion, and matters involving Hu Bin and Wu Wenlin remain pending with Shenzhen police.

data.title: Gryphon Capital Income Trust Reports Unit Purchase Plan Results
data.description:
Gryphon Capital Income Trust ( (AU:GCI) ) has provided an update.

Gryphon Capital Income Trust (ASX: GCI) is an income trust managed by Gryphon Capital Investments. The manager’s Australian asset-based finance platform, Barings Asset-Based Finance Australia, has significant experience in Australian and international fixed-income markets and manages more than A$6.5 billion in assets.

The trust received binding applications for 5,909,250 new units at A$2.00 each, raising A$11,818,500 under a non-underwritten unit purchase plan. All valid applications were accepted in full without scale-back, and the proceeds are to support incremental portfolio management consistent with the trust’s investment strategy; the new units will rank equally with existing units.
